Prompt 19 — Reconcile the diagnostic feedback template before the VM run

Context
-------
Read .github/copilot-instructions.md, feedback/README.md, the newest
feedback/airgap-run-*.md files, and inspect the current learner-VM
scripts and lab-vm.conf.

The operator reports:
- feedback/airgap-run-001.md already existed and was preserved.
- feedback/airgap-run-002.md was created as the next diagnostic
  template.
- That template records `00-diagnose v11`.
- Subsequent changes generalised artifact handling in Prompt 18 and
  may have changed the current diagnostic version.

The operator can transfer only the Git repository. All current
changes must be committed and made available through the repository
before the VM can use them. Do not commit or push unless explicitly
asked.

This task runs on the connected upstream machine only. Do not access
the learner VM or run provisioning against it.

Objective
---------
Verify that the pending diagnostic template accurately describes the
current checked-out `00-diagnose.sh`, update only stale template
metadata, and provide an exact pre-transfer handoff.

Task 1 — verify script version and artifact inputs
--------------------------------------------------
1. Read the actual `SCRIPT_VERSION` and CHANGE comment in
   learner-vm/scripts/00-diagnose.sh.
2. Compare them with the version recorded in
   feedback/airgap-run-002.md.
3. If they differ, update only that metadata line in
   feedback/airgap-run-002.md to the current version. Do not alter
   feedback/airgap-run-001.md or any report content.
4. Confirm the current diagnostic checks the artifact catalog and
   manual-first paths for:
   - `$MANUAL_FETCH_DIR/k3s/k3s`
   - `$MANUAL_FETCH_DIR/k3s/k3s-airgap-images-amd64.tar.zst`
5. Confirm the current resolver contract: valid local file wins;
   invalid local checksum fails without a network attempt; URL is
   fallback; the airgap archive is optional.
6. If any of these facts do not match the code, report the mismatch.
   Do not silently modify provisioning behavior in this task.

Task 2 — transfer readiness report
----------------------------------
Inspect `git status --short` and identify the files required for the
next VM run. Do not stage, commit, reset, or clean anything.

Report:
- whether feedback/airgap-run-002.md now names the current diagnostic
  version;
- current diagnostic script version and its CHANGE comment;
- whether the repository contains the artifact catalog, resolver,
  required workshop content, and current provisioning scripts;
- the exact relative paths that must be included in the next Git
  commit for the VM run;
- any unrelated or generated files that should not be included;
- whether the diagnostic self-test and bash syntax check have already
  been run against the current working tree, and their recorded result.

Do not claim that the learner VM, Artifactory, k3s, or container
image pulls have been tested.

Task 3 — operator handoff
-------------------------
Print the exact post-commit VM-side sequence, using the repository's
actual directory layout and current script version:

1. obtain the committed repository on the RHEL VM;
2. set `K3S_BINARY_URL` in `learner-vm/lab-vm.conf` only if neither
   required artifact is manually staged and the URL fallback is
   needed;
3. run `sudo bash scripts/00-diagnose.sh` from the
   `learner-vm/` directory;
4. paste the complete report block into
   `feedback/airgap-run-002.md`, preserving it verbatim.

Clearly state that the operator must not run scripts 10–80 until the
diagnostic report has been reviewed.

Constraints
-----------
- Do not stage or commit changes.
- Do not alter provisioning scripts or the resolver.
- Do not alter feedback/airgap-run-001.md.
- Update feedback/airgap-run-002.md only if its recorded diagnostic
  version is stale.
- Do not access the learner VM.

Acceptance
----------
1. Report the actual `00-diagnose.sh` version and whether the
   run-002 template matches it.
2. Paste the updated version line if it changed.
3. Paste `git status --short` and the list of required commit paths.
4. Paste the exact VM-side sequence.
5. Explicitly state that no VM command, provisioning script, or
   Artifactory fetch was executed.
